purpose: Teach: キャロル/スクルージ/兵衛/モモ/ポップス/社民党/アントニオ/ピエール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがクリスマス・キャロルを朗読された
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he used to read the Christmas Carol aloud.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle pause after the apostrophe, voice reaching back into memory. Slow cadence. Each detail lingers slightly, like he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、スクルージみたいに節約されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes — and you were just like old Scrooge yourself, weren't you, dear? Always pinching pennies.
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing. A small, knowing laugh under the surface. Familiar rhythm of an old inside joke. Affectionate without sweetness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが甘い兵衛の名で呼ばれた
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, people used to call him Amasuke — the sweet-toothed one.
lines.style: Same wistful quality. Voice softens on the nickname, lingering on the affection it carried. Quiet wonder at how specific a life gets.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、モモの缶詰を毎月買ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you bought yourself those tins of peaches every single month, didn't you, dear? You did.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact certainty. Not accusatory — confirming a detail she's kept close. Warm knowing. Light affectionate insistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが昭和のポップスを好まれた
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he loved Showa pop songs.
lines.style: Tender, reaching back. Voice catches slightly on the music memory. Slower still. Each word is a step into a time he holds.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、社民党時代を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, you were always missing those days too, weren't you? The good old SDP years.
lines.style: Gentle, conspiratorial. Light affection mixed with recognition of his longing. Not mocking — understanding. Familiar shared nostalgia.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアントニオ・ガウディに憧れた
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he admired Antonio Gaudí.
lines.style: Voice opens with wonder. Reverence on the architect's name. Breath held slightly, like he's still looking at something beautiful. Pacing slow and deliberate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ピエール・カルダンの服を着てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And there you were wearing Pierre Cardin suits like you were the real artist yourself.
lines.style: Warm, amused affection. Small knowing smile in the voice. Gently teasing but without edge. Close and intimate, trailing softly on the final image.
